ContinuationCapture.outer_control_chain.observation_site: Machine::capture_template at the existing ContinuationCapture record.
ContinuationCapture.outer_control_chain.observation_time: Snapshot the actual retained machine frame stack at capture; preserve frame indices and original stack order.
ContinuationCapture.outer_control_chain.scope: Record every listed owner/control boundary actually present in the retained frame stack, in stack order. Keep the inner signal Catch identity joinable by exact event, handler occurrence, source site and owner; keep surrounding outer receiver/control entries distinct.
ContinuationCapture.outer_control_chain.separate_from: PendingRequest.suffix and HygieneSuffixEvidence. The outer chain must not be appended to suffix or reported as captured suffix membership.

fields.disposition: BorrowedActive when the resolved owner is reused; FreshInvocation when the existing code creates a fresh invocation.
fields.node_index: Exact node index within that template.
fields.previous_owner: current_owner immediately before this Owner node.
fields.selected_owner: Actual owner selected by the existing active-owner or fresh-invocation branch.

TemplateOwnerResolution.fresh_link: When FreshInvocation is selected, preserve the exact invocation identity and link it to the existing OwnerOpen call/provider record; do not mint or alter an owner for observation.
TemplateOwnerResolution.observation_time: After resolve_control and borrowed/fresh owner selection, before assigning current_owner and entering inner node.
TemplateOwnerResolution.ordering: The record follows the matching ContinuationApply and precedes execution of the resumed inner node and any retained write Request.

non_goals_and_open_premises: No runtime or language semantic change, no new grant authority, no fixture or expected-output change.

R2 observations alone do not establish native Grant, RootComp image/receipt reachability, History construction, original A/B closure, whole-language effect hygiene, soundness, principality, termination or production approval.
The R1 Lean module stays frozen with its reviewed conditional interpretation; any R2-to-Lean applicability requires separate final review and does not trigger another Lean audit.
preserved_r1_invariants: Every R1 transition and field keeps its original meaning and observation time.
ContinuationApply records invocation of the continuation; it is not a later owner-resolution event.
ContinuationCapture.suffix records only frames actually saved in PendingRequest.suffix.
Runtime owner selection, activity checks, control-map resolution, freshening, receiver behavior, RootComp behavior and grants are unchanged.
validator_obligations: Join ContinuationApply to the exact template, then to the actual TemplateOwnerResolution event; never equate application owner with retained Request.owner absent an observed transition.
Join retained write Request and CatchCandidate/CatchCommit to the exact outer CatchReturn installation/control chain and its actual resolved owner.

Check event order and reject substitutions/removals of template, node, original/resolved/selected/previous owner, disposition, outer boundary, handler occurrence/site, request event and chain ordering.
Keep ContinuationResponse value and view joins independent from control-owner joins, then link both to the exact retained write request.
Preserve and exercise all earlier callback/companion mutation families and exact source/result checks (1 and 23).
